title: Car production bar chart (2014‑2018)
subject: Economics
caption: Grouped bar chart of car production for companies X, Y, and Z from 2014 to 2018.
altText: A grouped bar chart showing annual car production for three companies (X in red, Y in green, Z in blue) over the years 2014 to 2018. The vertical axis (left) marks production in thousands from 0 to 250, and the horizontal axis (bottom) lists each year. For each year, three adjacent bars represent the production numbers: X (120‑250), Y (100‑220), and Z (80‑200) thousand units. A legend in the upper right identifies the colors for X, Y, and Z. The chart includes axis labels, tick marks, and a title at the top.
